title: Visualize shipment and finance progress count groups
description: A sales user explores the current authorized shipment and finance progress page using finite grouping and evidence summaries. Development only. Reuse ERP-156 bounded ERP-032 preview; on each request recheck current-user sales-order menu and SalespersonDataScopeService customer scope before reading, and use existing HTTP operation audit. Keep grouping to the same current page; preserve null unknown shipment and linked-payment evidence, separate currencies, and never present uncovered amount as receivables or payment authority. Invalid modes and denied users fail closed. No arbitrary SQL, migrations, production SQL, real database execution, writes, secrets/.env change or deployment. Verify focused unit/Node tests and safe Release build/test; no real-browser acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Existing designer offers only ERP-160 count grouping keys and sends the chosen key with its current authorized bounded preview request.
A safe labeled count view renders customer, currency, shipment and finance-link groups including unknown classes, empty pages and pagination changes without interpreting counts as settlement.
Node tests cover grouping choice, safe text rendering, unknown and empty classes, permission/network failures and page changes; document page-only meaning.
